title: Hunts FH-005: Add versioned Hunt schema

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 0, Engine. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail:
Create isolated Hunt, role, partner, version, mission, group and placement relations with tenant-aware composite FKs. Done when: Cross-Hunt ref and enum violation fail and user roles lack raw write access. Requires: FH-003, FH-004. Owner role: Database.

Migration 20270346031000 adds the ten authoring tables (service role only, composite FKs keep children inside their Hunt). pgTAP in supabase/tests/hunts_schema.test.sql, source-shape guard in lib/hunts/schema.test.ts. Decisions D1 (Hunt-only evidence table) and D2 (members play, public browse and entry) recorded by the owner 2026-11-09.
